responsibility: Implements the small mc bootstrap runtime support for language-defined termination paths such as case-selection failure and missing function return. It emits fixed diagnostics for CaseException, ReturnException, and the bootstrap _throw stub, then exits immediately, providing the low-level error endpoints used by generated Modula-2 code.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file in the Gmcrts same-name pair: it defines the runtime termination routines and the internal bootstrap _throw stub, emitting diagnostics and exiting. The companion header only declares the callable exception interfaces.
